QuestInfo.0: Just when you seemed to be in grave danger, suddenly, your Master's spirit appeared to rescue you from the clutches of evil.
QuestInfo.1: Even after all that's happened, you still chose to make your way adventuring in the outside world, and prepare to set out on the Nimbus Cloud.
QuestInfo.2: From this point on, you'll have to forge your own way in the magical arts. Perhaps one day you'll be able to impress your Master with your progress!
